source_checks.finding: Page section 'Listen to all text' says 'To have pages read aloud to you, turn on your Chromebook's built-in screen reader:'. Step 1: select the time at the bottom right, or press Alt + Shift + s. Step 2: select Settings, then Accessibility. Step 3: under 'Text-to-Speech,' turn on ChromeVox. Tip: Ctrl + Alt + z turns ChromeVox on or off from any page. All target steps are supported.

This is the Android procedure. It does not apply to this user (Chromebook) and is correctly unused.
